unknown; an absent histogram is never zero latency
unknown and probe-path failure; replay timestamp age is not a substitute

postgresql_native.question: 当前谁在运行、空闲、等待或持有锁
postgresql_native.snapshot_semantics: current activity is dynamic, but a statistics snapshot can remain stable within a transaction
postgresql_native.caution: state and wait_event are independent; active plus wait means executing but blocked

postgresql_native.question: 数据库工作量、命中、临时文件、冲突和错误如何累计
postgresql_native.snapshot_semantics: cumulative counters require stats_reset and elapsed time
postgresql_native.caution: counter value is not a rate and a reset is not an improvement

postgresql_native.question: 后端类型在何种对象和上下文产生 I/O
postgresql_native.snapshot_semantics: cumulative by backend_type, object and context
postgresql_native.caution: cannot distinguish physical disk from operating-system page cache; combine with host evidence

postgresql_native.question: WAL、检查点和归档是否推进
postgresql_native.snapshot_semantics: cumulative counts plus last-success and last-failure timestamps
postgresql_native.caution: failed_count greater than zero is historical; alert on new failures and stalled success, then verify pgBackRest

postgresql_native.question: 复制发送和回放位置是否收敛
postgresql_native.caution: zero WAL distance does not prove a particular committed token is visible on the routed read path

postgresql_native.question: 表维护、冻结风险和对象增长是否受控
postgresql_native.snapshot_semantics: mix of estimates, cumulative counters and current progress
postgresql_native.caution: dead tuples and bloat estimates are evidence for investigation, not interchangeable facts
